title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: a careful, convention-tracking derivation of the classical action of SL(2,Z) on the Poincaré half-plane, starting from Grothendieck's transcendental description of a complex elliptic curve. He describes E by a lattice Π = H (rank 2, oriented by ω) together with a complex line L ⊂ H⊗C, where L lies in the 'positive' half Σ*_{V,ω} of P^1(V⊗C) and V = H⊗R. A 'rigidification de Torelli' is an oriented isomorphism u: Z^2 → H (modern term: a Teichmüller marking, i.e. an oriented basis of H_1). On the previous page he identified D = {Im z > 0} with Σ*_{R^2,ω_0} via z ↦ L_z = C·(z e_1 + e_2).

On this page: for z = x+iy ∈ D, the C-linear structure on V = R^2 is transported through the real-part map φ: L_z → V, λ(z e_1+e_2) ↦ Re(λ(z e_1+e_2)). Writing λ = a+ib gives λ(ze_1+e_2) = [(ax−by)+i(ay+bx)]e_1 + (a+ib)e_2, so φ(λ) = (ax−by)e_1 + a e_2. Solving φ(λ_1) = e_1 and φ(λ_2) = e_2 gives λ_1 = −i/y and λ_2 = 1+ix/y. Hence λ_2/λ_1 = i(y+ix) = −x+iy.

He then passes to the complex structure relevant for the tangent space t_E ≅ V_C/L. That structure is the conjugate of the one transported from L. So in t_E the quotient e_2/e_1 equals the conjugate of −x+iy, namely −x−iy = −z, which lies in D^-.

Conclusion: if the Torelli structure is given by the basis (z_1, z_2) of Π ⊂ t_E, the corresponding point of D is recovered from z_2/z_1 = −z, i.e. z = −z_2/z_1 (written (24), with a stray conjugation bar). He then sets up g = (a b; c d) ∈ SL(2,Z), acting on the right on markings by u ↦ u∘g. The next page computes z' = (dz−b)/(−cz+a) for u∘g, and therefore the 'formule habituelle' z' = (az+b)/(cz+d) for u∘g^{-1}.

Purpose: to fix sign, orientation and conjugation conventions so that the moduli of marked elliptic curves is D with the standard Möbius action. The quotient then gives the moduli of elliptic curves (and, with level structure, the modular curves needed for his study of moduli of elliptic curves in characteristic ≠ 2).
errors: Formula (24) as written, z = −(z_2/z_1)^- with a conjugation bar, is inconsistent with the line just above (e_2/e_1 = −z in the t_E structure). It is also inconsistent with the next page, which uses z' = −z'_2/z'_1 without conjugation. The bar appears to be a leftover of the crossed-out version, and the correct relation is z = −z_2/z_1.

The passage from λ_2/λ_1 = −x+iy to e_2/e_1 = conj(−x+iy) is not justified on the page. It is correct only if the complex structure on V is taken from t_E = V_C/L (conjugate to the one from L) rather than from L via φ. This implicit switch is the whole source of the sign and conjugation bookkeeping.
Minor: z_2/z_1 = −z lies in D^-, consistent with the orientation convention z_1∧z_2 = ω; Grothendieck notes '∈ D^-' correctly.

ideas.what: Moduli of complex elliptic curves with an oriented basis of H_1 ('rigidification de Torelli') identified with the upper half-plane via the period ratio, with SL(2,Z) acting on markings on the right
ideas.modern_name: Teichmüller space T_{1,1} ≅ upper half-plane; period map; marked elliptic curves
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Gauss, Jacobi, Klein, Riemann; Teichmüller theory)
ideas.where_published: Teichmüller groupoids and T_{1,1} are discussed qualitatively in Esquisse d'un programme; this explicit computation is not, as far as I know.

ideas.what: Explicit verification that the right action u ↦ u∘g^{-1} on markings induces z ↦ (az+b)/(cz+d), tracking conjugate complex structures (L versus V_C/L)
ideas.modern_name: Modular action of SL(2,Z) on the upper half-plane; sign and conjugation conventions for period ratios

deep.surprise_reason: A routine, if meticulous, convention check deriving the standard Möbius action from Hodge-theoretic data (lattice plus complex line). The only idiosyncrasy is the terminology 'rigidification de Torelli' for a Teichmüller marking. Nothing new or uncredited.
transcription_corrections: First line: 'explicitons cette relation entre deux générations' is doubtful. The image reads more like 'explicitons cette action en termes de [coordonnées?] sur D'; the word read as 'générations' is uncertain.
'π ⊂ ^tE' should be 'Π ⊂ t_E' (lattice in the tangent space of E).
(24) should read z = −(z_2/z_1)^- with z_1, not z, in the denominator. Struck out: 'z_2/z_1 = −x+iy = −z̄ où z = x+iy'.
'L_z ⇒ C(z,1)' is an identification of L_z with C.(z,1) (written with = / ⇌), not an implication.
The label '(24)' sits under the struck formula on the left margin, i.e. it numbers the formula z = −(z_2/z_1)^-.
